videos.title: 골드만삭스가 던진 코스피 12000…보수적 전망이라는 진짜 이유
videos.subtitle_summary:
The user wants a summary of a YouTube video transcript in Korean, approximately 500 characters, with 3-5 sentences covering the key points.
Key points from the transcript:
1. Goldman Sachs predicted KOSPI 12,000, calling it "conservative"
2. Main drivers: semiconductor supercycle (HBM, Samsung/SK Hynix), Value-up policy (share buybacks, dividends reducing Korea Discount)
3. Foreign capital inflows increasing, global funds raising Korea allocation
4. Improved macro conditions: OECD raised growth forecast (1.7%→2.6%), trade surplus stable, favorable exchange rate
5. Credit rating upgrades (LG Electronics), reassessment of Korean manufacturing competitiveness
6. AI infrastructure investment impact (Nvidia considering AI tech center in Korea)
7. Risks remain (global rates, US big tech earnings, China recovery), but overall trend is positive
